subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “Engineers built a small model of an ancient bridge to test how it stood without modern materials.”?
options: Modern societies also risk losing knowledge through disasters, neglect, war, or technology changes.
Many visitors came to buy plants, but they left with knowledge too.
The guide explained that printing technology once changed the spread of knowledge.
They did not have modern computers, but they had deep practical knowledge.
